features: Build mode groups — floors, wallpaper, walls, doors and plants are split into tabs like Carpet, Wood, Tile, Fences, Arches and Trees.
Buy mode groups — big categories have smaller tabs, like Art, Mirrors and Rugs in Decorative, or Sofas and Beds in Seating.
updates: Catalog — the tab you picked last opens again next time.

features: Townies — lots have people around: some are already there when you arrive, and neighbours walk by your home.
Call a taxi — use the phone to visit a neighbour, a community lot or Downtown.
updates: Smarter Sims — Sims find things to do on their own, and your orders always come first.
Shop staff — talk to and use the services of clerks, waiters and other staff.
Phone — calling a friend works again, even when your Sim doesn't know anyone yet.

features: New items on the Test server — new floors, walls and wall pictures will appear on the Test server first.

updates: Smarter Sims — a Sim stops retrying a chore they can't get to and comes back to it later.
Updates — while a new version is on its way you can still play single player; online opens once your game is updated.
Launcher — a taller launcher with all the patch notes, and a simpler sign-in box.
Online play — smoother for everyone when a player's game falls out of step.
Bug fixes — lots of fixes for crashes and glitches across the game, the launcher and online play.
Magic Town — families can move into the Magic Town lots again.
Online play — smoother joining and leaving, and visitors can't switch to the host's Sims.
Launcher — you can type spaces, scroll with the mouse wheel, and it fits on phones.
F1 — switches to Live mode, like the original game.
Launcher background — a new photo-collage background.
Refresh button — when a new version is out, press Refresh to get it.

features: New logo — The Sims Redux logo on the neighborhood bar and the launcher.
Online button — a new rounded Online button on the neighborhood bar.
updates: Family faces — each Sim's head is centred in its picture.
Buy and Build — the icons sit right on the new bar.
Neighborhood bar — tidier logo and version text with more room.
Control panel — money is centred, and the clock and money text is smaller and tidier.
Neighborhood bar — the top bar gets the new look, with the buttons sitting smoothly in it.

features: New look — a smoother control panel in the classic Sims blue, with the original icons.
Interface options — choose the Redux or Classic look, a UI colour and a UI size.
Moderator tools — moderators can help run the town from the launcher.
Server warnings — you're told before the server restarts or shuts down.
updates: Maintenance — the launcher shows when the server is closed for upkeep.

features: Account sign-up — new accounts add your name and an email for password resets.
updates: Sign-in screen — simplified to Log in and Create account.

features: Server picker — choose the Live or Test server, with live online status.
Message of the day — server news and running events, right on the launcher.
Update check — the launcher makes sure your game is up to date before you play.
Levels and XP — earn XP playing online and level up your account.
Report a player — send a report to the admin from the launcher.
Town announcements — server messages and events pop up while you're in the online town.
updates: Smarter Sims — Sims leave other Sims' plates alone.
Smarter Sims — Sims no longer stop to chat in doorways.

features: Game launcher — patch notes, your account and game files in one place.
Server status — see whether the server is online and how many players are on.
Play button — the game only starts loading when you press Play.
updates: Faster start — if you're logged in, you go straight to the launcher.
Account options — switch account, log out or change your game folder from the launcher.
Loading crash — fixed a crash while the website was loading.
Mod sounds — a mod with broken sound files no longer stops the game.

features: Fire safety — a grown-up calls the fire department when there's a fire.
Repairman — Sims call the repairman when nobody at home can fix something.
updates: Fires — Sims keep clear of a fire.
Quiet hours — Sims keep it down around sleeping Sims.

features: Sim Smarts: Off — a new setting that turns off free will in single player.
updates: Meals and sleep — Sims finish their meals and sleep through the night.
Chores — Sims pay bills and fix things when their needs are met.
Snacks — Sims with low Cooking grab a snack instead of cooking.
Steadier Sims — Sims stop bouncing between the same activities.
